description: Build or complete a server from a blueprint: a built-in template (list_templates), a saved export (file), or a layout you write (blueprint: {roles, categories:[{name, overrides, channels:[{name, type, topic, slowmode, tags, overrides}]}], channels}). mode "plan" lists the steps without changing anything; "apply" does them. Only what is missing is created, matching names loosely (emojis and dashes ignored), so it is safe to run again to continue. Nothing is deleted.

background.description: Apply as a background job (for big layouts); follow it with job_status

for_bots.description: Give this role to the bots in the server, e.g. a "Bots" role shown separately

bot.description: Use this bot (name or id) instead of choosing automatically

copy_from_server.description: Copy the structure of another server a configured bot is in

discord_template.description: A Discord server template link (discord.new/… or discord.com/template/…) or its code, e.g. from a template website

dry_run.description: Show the requests that would be made without changing anything

file.description: Path of a blueprint JSON (e.g. from export_server_structure)

server.description: Server name or id. Optional when the bot is in one server or DISCORD_GUILD_ID is set.

update_existing.description: Also move existing channels into the blueprint's categories, update roles that differ and reorder

name: apply_blueprint
